title: FIIs increase stake: 11 Nifty stocks rally up to 50% in FY27 so far - Smart money support | The Economic Times
text:
Tracking foreign institutional investor (FII) activity can offer insights into market trends, as these investors typically make stock selections based on detailed research and conviction. An analysis of the Nifty 50 universe shows that FIIs increased their stake in 19 companies in the September 2026 quarter compared with the June 2026 quarter. Interestingly, 11 of these stocks have delivered gains ranging from 10% to 50% in FY27 so far, highlighting how several stocks attracting increased foreign investor interest have also witnessed strong price momentum. (Data Source: ACE Equity)

The stock has rallied 50% in FY27 so far, rising from Rs 229 to Rs 344. Meanwhile, FIIs increased their stake to 33.01% in the September 2026 quarter from 29.09% in the June 2026 quarter.

The stock has gained 47% in FY27 so far, climbing from Rs 1,759 to Rs 2,579. FIIs raised their stake to 10.66% in the September 2026 quarter from 8.77% in the previous quarter.
